source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.13 with Figure 12.11, printed page 284.

blocks.text: Sulfur ka sab se bara hissa, taqreeban 85%, sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) banane mein istemal hota hai. H₂SO₄ ki banawat tetrahedral hai, jis mein do S−O (single) aur do S=O (double) bonds hain (Figure 12.11).

blocks.alt: Baen: H2SO4 ki banawat, S ke oopar do double bond wale O aur neeche do OH groups. Surkh dohre teer bond ki lambaiyan dete hain: S=O 142.2 pm, S-O 157.4 pm aur O-H 97 pm. Daen: ball-and-stick manzar, beech mein peela S, chaar surkh O aur neeche wale do O par do safed H.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.11: H2SO4 ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 12.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: S=O double bond (142.2 pm) S-O single bond (157.4 pm) se chhota hai, kyunke double bond mazboot hota hai aur atoms ko qareeb kheenchta hai. Chaaron O, S ke gird tetrahedral tarteeb mein hain, aur S ki oxidation state +6 hai.

blocks.prompt: Sulphuric acid ki banawat banayein aur is mein sulfur ki oxidation state batayein (exercise Q.2j; MCQ IX).
blocks.explanation: Beech mein sulfur, chaar oxygen atoms tetrahedral tarteeb mein: do S=O aur do S–OH. H = +1, O = −2: 2(+1) + S + 4(−2) = 0, is liye S = +6.

blocks.alt: Sulphuric acid ka Lewis structural formula: beech mein S, oopar aur neeche do O double bonds se, baen aur daen do OH groups single bonds se. Har O par do lone pairs ke dots. S ke paas laal daire mein +6 likha hai, aur neeche hisaab: 2(+1) + S + 4(-2) = 0, is liye S = +6.
blocks.caption: Jawab ka diagram (pehle khud banayein, phir milayein): H₂SO₄ ki banawat (do S=O, do S–OH, sab lone pairs) aur sulfur ki oxidation state +6.
blocks.long_description: Diagram mein sulfur beech mein hai. Oopar aur neeche ke oxygen atoms S se double bond (S=O) se jure hain, aur baen aur daen ke oxygen atoms single bond se S aur H dono se jure hain (S–O–H). Har oxygen par do lone pairs (do do dots) hain; sulfur par koi lone pair nahi. Laal daira sulfur ki oxidation state +6 dikhata hai: do H ka +2, chaar O ka −8, is liye S = +6. Asal molecule mein chaar O atoms S ke gird tetrahedral tarteeb mein hote hain.

items: Taqreeban 85% sulfur H₂SO₄ banane mein jata hai.
H₂SO₄: tetrahedral, do S=O aur do S–OH bonds; S = +6.
